Definition: Jigal, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Igal or Igeal = "He redeems"; 1) son of Joseph and a spy from the tribe of Issachar; 2) son of Nathan of Zobah, one of David's mighty warriors; 3) a son of Shemaiah and descendant of Zerubbabel
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
